prompt:
CHARACTER SHEET — adult coastal seabird, four views and one wings-open pose on one frame, stylized animated-feature studio character presentation.

SUBJECT — One fully fictional adult coastal seabird shown consistently across five views. LEFT to RIGHT: front standing view, three-quarter standing view, full side view, back view, and one wings-open flight pose. Identical bird in every view, with the same proportions, feather pattern, beak, feet, eyes and wing markings.

DESIGN — Compact socially confident coastal seabird with a slightly rounded body, stable center of gravity, broad practical wings and sturdy webbed feet. Main feather mass is warm off-white #F2F0EB. Primary wing tips and tail accents are charcoal #2B2B2B. Beak and feet are warm ochre-orange #E8A33D. Small dark attentive eyes with restrained highlights.

Feather construction uses clean overlapping stylized groups rather than individually rendered feathers. The neck, chest and belly form one appealing continuous silhouette. Wing layers remain clearly separated for flying, folding, preening and laying one wing across another bird’s back. Add subtle salt wear and slightly roughened outer wing edges. The standing posture is relaxed and balanced; the wings-open pose shows a broad unhurried wing stroke.

LAYOUT — Five views shown at consistent scale across a 16:9 frame. Full bird visible from beak to feet or wingtip in every view. Even spacing, centered on a solid neutral gray seamless studio background, flat mid-gray edge to edge, no gradient. Feet grounded with soft contact shadows. Large softbox key with gentle fill reveals feather-layer construction and wing markings.

STYLE — High-end stylized 3D animated-feature character design presented as an 8K professional production turnaround. Tactile matte feathers, slightly tighter highlights on the beak and feet, accurate weight and readable silhouette, neutral color grading, WB 5600K.

CONSTRAINTS — 16:9. Background stays solid neutral gray. Same exact bird in all five views. Off-white body #F2F0EB, charcoal accents #2B2B2B, ochre-orange beak and feet #E8A33D. NO accessories, clothing, tags or bands. NO real-world species markings requiring exact natural-history accuracy. NO environment or additional birds. Clean unlabeled production character sheet.
